contexts.text: The cataracts of heaven being opened () = the last degree of temptation as to intellectual things... The cataracts of heaven are spoken of from the inundation of falsities, or of reasonings; which are also spoken of in Isaiah... The cataracts from on high are open (). AC 760:end. AC 845. AC 1066.
The cataracts which are open from on high () = an inundation of evil and falsity.
